about_the_game:
This is a casual puzzle game that is easy, fun and full of strategies. Here, you will become a "master of synthesis" with both wisdom and strategy. Through clever operations and strategies, you can continuously synthesize and upgrade cute girls, challenge your own limits, and unlock more surprises. It is easy to get started but brain-burning. Come and build your own beautiful girl alliance!

Dream world, healing journey

The game has 5 beautiful map scenes, with 12 beautiful girl characters of different styles, from playful loli to gentle queen. Each girl is exquisite and cute, and the picture is pleasing to the eye, allowing you to enjoy a visual and spiritual healing feast after synthesis.

Simple rules, infinite strategies

Summon and synthesis: Click the currency button in the lower right corner of the hall to summon your beautiful girl partner with gold coins. Drag and merge two beautiful girls of the same level to upgrade to a higher-level beautiful girl. The higher the level, the greater the charm!

Challenge the limit: The game venue can accommodate up to 20 beautiful girls. If the number exceeds the limit, the game ends. How to synthesize a more advanced beautiful girl in a limited space tests your strategy and planning ability.

Gold Coin Accumulation: 2000 gold coins (2K) are given at the beginning. You can use 2K gold coins to buy 1 level 1 beautiful girl and synthesize it into level 2; 2 level 2 beautiful girls synthesize 1 level 3, and so on. The purchase price of higher-level beautiful girls soars - level 2 requires 2 million gold coins (2M), and level 3 requires 2 billion gold coins (2B)! The output of gold coins is linked to the level and number of characters, and the more you play, the more you feel accomplished.

Game Features Introduction

Brain-burning strategy: Should you give priority to synthesizing high-level beautiful girls, or accumulate gold coins to buy them directly? Every decision affects your progress, and there are infinite possibilities hidden in leisure.

Exquisite graphics: From scenes to characters, every frame is as exquisite as a work of art, allowing you to relax and enjoy it.

Opening gift: New players will receive 2K gold coins + 1 random level 1 beautiful girl when they log in, and easily synthesize your first level 2 partner.

Easy decompression: Get started without pressure, enjoy the fun of synthesis anytime, anywhere, perfect for fragmented time.

Cute and healing: Exquisite beautiful girl design + dreamy scenes will capture your girlish heart.
